intro.zh: 采集与审核简报已发布，本期未收录新论文。发布前采集与审核记录：北京时间08:07–08:11实际尝试12路信源。HF今日榜未就绪（开放至11/06），已完整复抓11/05的39篇与11/06的31篇，补齐46个新身份和4项推荐日，完成三轮复核：2项纳入、48项范围排除，归期仍为原推荐日。三路arXiv查询成功但返回0；GitHub检查13个仓库、窗口内release为0；RSS五路成功，窗口内共58条。S2引文仅取到首批100条中的7个窗口内条目，后续与作者追踪均遇429，未覆盖部分未知。本期是采集与审核简报，不声称新增论文或全天无更新。
intro.en: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: All 12 enabled sources were attempted at 08:07–08:11 Asia/Shanghai. Today’s HF board was not ready (available through Nov 6); the complete Nov 5 and Nov 6 boards contained 39 and 31 papers. Reconciliation added 46 identities and four recommendation dates; three-round review supported two inclusions and 48 scope exclusions, retaining their original HF dates. Three arXiv queries succeeded with zero results; 13 GitHub repositories had zero releases in the source window. All five RSS feeds succeeded, returning 58 window entries. S2 citations yielded seven window entries from the first 100 raw records before 429 throttling; citation continuation and author tracking were not fully collected. This is a collection and review brief, not a claim of new papers or no updates for the whole day.
